input.short_description: Create, list, and manage pipelines via the v3 REST API with improved error handling and pagination.
input.body:
Pipelines endpoint {{ds:component/chip|label=v3|variant=success}}

Create and manage pipelines programmatically. Base URL: https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v3.

v3 is the current API version. v2 docs remain available for users still on the previous version.

What's new in v3

  • Improved error responses: Richer error details with field-level validation messages
  • Cursor pagination enhancements: Configurable page size and stable cursors across API calls
  • New state transitions: Pipelines can move directly from draft to paused
  • Enhanced webhooks: Real-time pipeline status change notifications

Create a pipeline

POST /v3/pipelines

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=namestringYesHuman-readable pipeline name, unique per workspace.source_connector_idstringYesID of the connector events are read from.destination_connector_idstringYesID of the connector events are written to.transformsarrayNoOrdered list of transform step definitions. Omit for a pass-through copy.schedulestringNoCron expression. Omit for event-triggered (streaming) pipelines.initial_statestringNoOne of draft or paused. Defaults to draft. (v3 new)}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-pipeline.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v3/pipelines \\\n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY\" \\\n -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n -d '{\n \"name\": \"ingest-orders\",\n \"source_connector_id\": \"conn_pg_orders\",\n \"destination_connector_id\": \"conn_snowflake_dw\",\n \"initial_state\": \"draft\"\n }'}}

List pipelines

GET /v3/pipelines — cursor-paginated. Supports optional page_size parameter (1–100, defaults to 20). See Rate limits & errors for the pagination envelope.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=list-pipelines.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X GET \"https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v3/pipelines?page_size=50\" \\\n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY\"}}

Pipeline states

Returned pipelines include a state field of draft, active, or paused — see Pipelines for what each means.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=Deleting a pipeline|body_html=

Deleting a pipeline does not delete its source or destination connectors, and does not delete events already written to the destination. In-flight runs are allowed to finish before deletion completes.

}} {{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=

Rate limits

Standard-tier accounts are rate-limited to 1,000 requests per minute per workspace. The remaining quota is returned in the X-RateLimit-Remaining response header.

Pagination

All list endpoints use cursor-based pagination. Responses include:

{{ds:component/code-block|language=json|code={ "items": [...], "pagination": { "next_cursor": "abc123def456", "has_more": true } }}}

Error responses

{{ds:component/code-block|language=json|code={ "error": { "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "Request failed validation", "details": { "fields": { "name": "Pipeline name is required" } } } }}}

Common error codes:

  • VALIDATION_ERROR (400) — Request body failed validation
  • NOT_FOUND (404) — Resource does not exist
  • CONFLICT (409) — Resource already exists (e.g., duplicate pipeline name)
  • RATE_LIMITED (429) — Rate limit exceeded; retry after the Retry-After header
  • INTERNAL_ERROR (500) — Unexpected server error
